To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Jasada bhasama is a nanosized zinc-based bhasma preparation that has a high surface area, and (2) Jasada bhashma and its nanoscale counterpart (ZnO nanoparticles) possess antidiabetic activity in experimental models of diabetes.
(i) the antidiabetic activity is due to the zinc content of Jasada bhaṣma and (ii) the antidiabetes activity of zinc oxide nanoparticles is comparable to that of Jasada bḥaṣma.
Jasada bhasmas and zinc oxide nanoparticles have significant antidiabetic activity in diabetic mice, which is comparable to the antidiabetic drug, glibenclamide.
